newsitem.title: ITALY: Versace family relieved murder case resolved.
newsitem.headline: Versace family relieved murder case resolved.

text.p: The brother and sister of fashion designer Gianni Versace said on Thursday they were relieved to close the chapter on his murder after the man accused of killing him was found dead in an apparent suicide.
"The Versace family is relieved and grateful to those who helped resolve the terrible murder of Gianni Versace," the Milan-based fashion house said in a brief statement.
Andrew Cunanan, the 27-year-old homosexual prostitute whom police had described as their only suspect, apparently shot himself after police cornered him on a houseboat in Miami Beach on Wednesday.
Police believed Versace, 50, who was shot in the head on the steps of his oceanfront Florida mansion last week, was Cunanan's fifth victim in a crazed killing spree.
Versace, whose flamboyant, sexy creations were sought after by rock stars and royalty, launched his first own-name collection at the age of 31 and built up a $1 billion business.
His brother Santo, the financial brain behind the empire, and sister Donatella, a designer and creator of the fashion house's Versus line, have vowed to continue the business.
They had asked for their privacy to be respected during a family funeral ceremony last week near the designer's villa on Lake Como and a memorial mass in Milan cathedral on Tuesday.
